result.text: The basic premise of Hearthwork, my peer-counseling framework, is: Equal time. Attention without interpretation, advice, or fixing. You speak. I listen. Then we switch. Presence, Warmth, Discipline, Confidentiality. It’s kind of a third type of relationship, alongside ordinary friendship and professional therapy, and one your little one might really need, because modern life rarely gives you anything like it.
